The world was slowly adjusting to the new normal and vaccinations became available, the global economy gradually recovered. The Malaysian economy was also gradually recovering in 2021. However, as the local daily COVID-19 cases began to surge in May 2021, the Government had to introduce stricter nationwide containment measures to curb the spread of coronavirus. The swift implementation of the National COVID-19 Immunisation programme enabled more economic sectors to gradually reopen in the third quarter of the year. clean_text: [MDA_P011] STRATEGIC DIRECTION Being the largest, most integrated and the leading bottled water company in Malaysia, we are committed to delivering high quality bottled water products to all Malaysians with special focus on health benefits and at the same time, catering to the sophisticated taste preference and the hydration needs of our consumers.
